content.text:
I found 5 Chicago permits issued in 2025 with a reported cost of at least $150 million:

| Permit | Address | Issued | Reported cost | Work |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 101068175 | 705 W Chicago Ave | 2025-08-19 | $396,200,000 | Core and shell for a 7-story casino, parking and event center plus a 34-story hotel tower |
| 101073691 | 370 N Morgan St | 2025-10-17 | $155,000,000 | Revision to permit 101059401 (ground-floor slab infill, lobby fireplace and ventilation changes) |
| 101059401 | 370 N Morgan St | 2025-07-14 | $155,000,000 | Full building permit for a 31-story residential building |
| 101060198 | 370 N Morgan St | 2025-05-30 | $155,000,000 | Excavation for grade beams only |
| 101050206 | 370 N Morgan St | 2025-05-23 | $155,000,000 | Caissons only |

Four of the five are for the same 31-story building at 370 N Morgan St. Each phased permit and the revision repeats the project's full $155 million cost, so adding the costs together would overstate the money spent. The city publishes costs as reported by applicants and doesn't check them.

FINAL ANSWER: 101073691, 101068175, 101059401, 101060198, 101050206
